demand.title: Kaiawhina Workforce RFP
demand.buyer: Health New Zealand | Te Whatu Ora
evidence: Current RFP seeks suitably qualified Pacific providers for a nationally consistent Pacific Kaiāwhina Navigation Service.
Providers must demonstrate Pacific governance, community relationships, workforce sustainability, reporting capability and related delivery capacity.

prospect.name: CJPJ & ASSOCIATES LIMITED
prospect.basis: GETS records show CJPJ & ASSOCIATES LIMITED was awarded the Pacific Health Science Academy Programme procurement in November 2025, with total spend reported as NZ$1,537,627. This establishes relevant Pacific-health procurement experience, not current intent to buy.

offer.name: GETS Opportunity Brief
offer.stripe_truth: Payment link is active in live mode; this is not evidence of a buyer or revenue.

message.text:
Kia ora CJPJ team,

I saw the current Health NZ Kaiawhina Workforce RFP (PH26-001), which closes 5 October. Given CJPJ's previous Pacific Health Science Academy procurement work, I thought this might be relevant.

We have a small NZ$49 service that turns a GETS tender into a concise evidence-backed brief: closing date, mandatory requirements, capability fit/gaps, key risks or questions, and source references. If useful, I can send you the link and we can prepare one against PH26-001.

No obligation at all. If it is not relevant, no problem.

Regards,
Josh

procedure: Read the supplied GETS tender source.
Extract close date, mandatory requirements, scope and explicit evaluation/delivery constraints.
Map requested capability against the supplied supplier context.
List material gaps, risks and unanswered questions.
Attach source references and preserve the source URL.
Deliver the completed brief after settled payment.

kill_condition: Do not send if the human reviewer rejects the prospect/message, if the prospect says the tender is irrelevant, or if the scope cannot be fulfilled from authoritative public source material.
